brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.evidence: 3-cell L-shaped base (piece:0,0,0, piece:0,1,0, piece:1,0,0) with 3 bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments for small notions like bobbins/buttons/needles), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-half-div2 (2 compartments for thread/scissors), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-half (open tray for fabric, tape, larger tools). Caps and joint bolts secure build.

Dressed with workshop/desk props as proxies: marker and pen in divided compartments (prop:3, prop:5), brush (prop:4), gaffer tape representing thread spool (prop:2), and small parts heap. No dedicated sewing props (scissors, thread spools, fabric) exist in catalog - check_build clear, look shows props visible.

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell sewing caddy with divided bins for small notions and open trays for larger supplies, capped and bolted, dressed with representative tools.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
